title: tool_doswin: increase allowable length of path sanitizer
body:
- Use 32767-1 instead of PATH_MAX-1 (260-1) as the maximum allowable length of a path.

Prior to this change 32767-1 was the maximum length only for UNC paths that had the `"\\?\"` prefix like `"\\?\longpath"`. Since then we added some workarounds to read longer paths by converting them to that format, but the sanitizer may be called before that happens.

Bug: https://github.com/curl/curl/issues/20044
Reported-by: Viktor Szakats

Closes #xxxxx

files.patch:
@@ -178,9 +178,6 @@ static CURLcode test_tool1604(const char *arg)
     { "COM56", 0,
       "COM56", SANITIZE_ERR_OK
     },
-    /* At the moment we expect a maximum path length of 259. I assume MS-DOS
-       has variable max path lengths depending on compiler that are shorter
-       so currently these "good" truncate tests will not run on MS-DOS */
     { "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
       "BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB"
       "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC"
